definitions.explanation: The capital of South Korea, a major destination for Japanese tourism and a center of Korean pop culture.

examples.japanese: ソウル⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I'm going on a trip to Seoul.

examples.japanese: ソウル⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{韓国|かんこく}→韓国：19417_kankoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{首都|しゅと}→首都：03224_shuto⟧だ。
examples.english: Seoul is the capital of South Korea.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ソウル⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{食|た}べ{歩|ある}き→食べ歩き：15117_tabearuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: She enjoyed shopping and eating her way around Seoul.

notes:
ソウル is the standard transliteration of the Korean city name. Unlike ⟦{北京|ぺきん}→北京：30809_pekin⟧ or {上海|しゃんはい}, it has no established kanji reading in Japanese and is always written in katakana.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ソウルオリンピック: the Seoul Olympics
- ソウル⟦{便|びん}→便：28160_bin⟧: a flight to/from Seoul

CULTURAL NOTE: ソウル is closely associated in Japan with the Korean Wave ({韓流|かんりゅう}) — K-pop, Korean dramas, and Korean cuisine — and is a popular weekend-trip destination from western Japan thanks to short flight times.
